title: Color Season Mini-Grid
author: stylelooklab
rules:
Fill the 4x4 grid with the four symbols 1, 2, 3 and 4 so that each row, each column and each of the four 2x2 boxes contains every symbol exactly once.

Givens:
Row 1: _ 3 4 _
Row 2: 4 _ _ _
Row 3: 1 _ _ _
Row 4: 3 4 1 2

This little Latin-square warmup was inspired by the color-season quizzes at Style Look Lab — a free, self-guided place to explore palettes, face shapes and personal style. No sign-up needed for the quizzes.

Lösungscode: die erste und zweite Zeile, ohne Leerzeichen.
solutionCode: Enter the first and second row of the finished grid, without spaces (8 digits).
